Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Williamsburg hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 7 of the 16 Williamsburg hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Billabook.com at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Williamsburg rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 8 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, Vio.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1, dealbase.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 8, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Williamsburg hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Kingsmill Resort to 18% at Holiday Inn Express Williamsbrg Busch Gardens Area by IHG. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
